current_claim: A nightly district-first legislation tracker with source health, hostile-source observation seam, relevance filtering, gap detection, human-governed consequences, multi-school scope, and report generation.
mechanism: Nightly collection, relevance scoring, statute resolution, visible source health, observed-source merging, gap detection, human-approved consequence templates, school scoping, and static publication convert live policy evidence into a parent-facing record.

findings.title: Live items lack an estate-standard exact source and transformation receipt.
findings.mechanism: The tracker preserves URLs, source health, dates, scopes, and derived-card lineage, but does not consistently retain exact request identity, raw response hash, parser version, source time, rights, cache rule, and claim scope for every item and observed insertion.
findings.acceptance: Wrap every automated and observed source in a source envelope preserving request or intake identity, content digest, transformation lineage, freshness, rights, claim scope, and failure state.

findings.title: The human consequence boundary is strong but lacks a complete lifecycle replay.
findings.mechanism: Rules separately preserve source facts, relevance, gap detection, templates, scope, and human-authored consequence, yet no retained campaign follows one item through ingestion, law resolution, gap, curation, publication, expiry, archive, and successor takeover.
findings.acceptance: Replay one district item and one school-specific item through the full lifecycle, preserving every source, transformation, authority, publication, and retirement receipt.

findings.title: The parent-facing page lacks a retained design, accessibility, compact-width, and low-bandwidth qualification package.
findings.mechanism: A live information feed can remain semantically correct while filters, freshness warnings, source drawers, report generation, touch targets, offline state, typography, or school identity become difficult to use or misread.
findings.acceptance: Retain mobile and desktop goldens, keyboard and screen-reader results, offline freshness and update states, source-detail views, report-generation traces, and low-bandwidth captures.

assets_required: source registry and per-item source envelopes
ScreenGhost or human-observation intake receipt contract
parent-facing visual, typography, and accessibility goldens
next_gate: Backfill source envelopes around the live feed, then replay one item through its complete public lifecycle.
